purpose: Teach: 開運/バレル/得票/ウエート/態様/勝率/内務省/文教

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、毎年開運祈願をされた
lines.en: Father — every year at the company's founding, he would offer prayers for good fortune.
lines.style: Quiet, measured recollection. Gentle lift on 'Father' as if summoning presence. Slow pace. Weight of memory settling in each phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは原油バレル価格を常に把握された
lines.en: Yes. Father always kept careful watch over the oil prices.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Direct eye contact held. No waver — the memory is clear. Simple conviction without embellishment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、株主総会で大量の得票を得られた
lines.en: Father — at the shareholders' meeting, he received an overwhelming vote of confidence.
lines.style: Softened wonder beneath the words. Slight trailing-off after 'Father.' Reverent pause before the accomplishment. Breathe through the admiration.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは評価ウエートを公平にされた
lines.en: Yes. Father made certain every evaluation was weighed fairly.
lines.style: Calm certainty. A steady nod in the voice. Matter-of-fact, but there's warmth underneath — defending his father's character through clarity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、お客様の態様を細かく分析された
lines.en: Father — he analyzed customer behavior down to the smallest detail.
lines.style: Gentle amazement. 'Father' carries a lift of affection. Slow, precise delivery on the phrase about analysis. Lingering on the precision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは交渉の勝率が高かった
lines.en: Yes. Father had a remarkable gift for winning negotiations.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Firm on 'winning' — not boastful, just factual. Even tempo. The voice of someone witnessing greatness and naming it plainly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、旧内務省人脈もお持ちだった
lines.en: Father — he also maintained connections with the old Home Ministry network.
lines.style: Soft acknowledgment of complexity. Slight pause before 'network' — this was part of his reach, understood without needing elaboration.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは文教振興にも貢献された
lines.en: Yes. And Father contributed significantly to the advancement of education.
lines.style: Warm closing. Gentle emphasis on 'education' — a legacy beyond business. Breath settles. The voice of someone honoring a full life, not just a career.
